title: Amounts the Policyholder Pays: Visit Copays, Annual Out-of-Pocket Limits and High Deductibles
content:
Under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies certain plan letters leave the policyholder a fixed copay on a visit before the policy pays, and certain letters carry an annual limit or an annual deductible of their own. Every amount is in USD.

| Policy | Office visit copay | Emergency department copay | Annual out-of-pocket limit | Annual high deductible |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 0.00 | 0.00 | none | none |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 0.00 | 0.00 | none | none |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 0.00 | 0.00 | none | none |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 0.00 | 0.00 | 7220.00 | none |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 20.00 | 50.00 | none | none |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 0.00 | 0.00 | none | none |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 0.00 | 0.00 | none | 2870.00 |

Where the table shows none, the figure carried by that letter is 0.00 and no limit or deductible of that kind applies to it.

### The same terms stated for the desk

The office visit copay is what the policyholder pays for an office visit before the policy pays, and the emergency department copay is what they pay for an emergency department visit that does not lead to admission. Only Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N carries either, at 20.00 on an office visit and 50.00 on an emergency department visit.

The annual out-of-pocket limit is the limit on what the policyholder pays in a calendar year before the policy pays everything. Only Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K carries one, at 7220.00.

The annual high deductible is the amount the policyholder meets in a calendar year before a high-deductible policy pays anything. Only Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G carries one, at 2870.00.
